briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI race toward 10^26 FLOP training runs amid escalating safety concerns

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model scaling as AGI timelines compress to 2027-2028. US-China compute export controls tighten while commercial deployments surge.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases o4 with 2T active parameters; Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus; xAI trains Colossus-2 cluster. DeepSeek-V4 matches GPT-5 performance at 40% lower cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announce 200k H200 clusters; TSMC ramps 2nm AI chips for 2027 delivery. Energy demand from AI data centers projected to hit 8% of US electricity by 2028.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent dialect protocols become mandatory infrastructure before the first AGI-level model is deployed?
